Good afternoon, Kashay,

I just called to discuss. We're happy to assist with getting you approved for a customs bond. To start that process, we will need the following:


  1.
Completed application - attached: Please make sure to include the information on all owners and spouses and also make sure to include the information on the “Activity Code”   The activity code and amount of the bond will come from CBP.
  2.
Letter from US Customs requesting new bond
  3.
How much in dues do you expect over the next 12-month period? This will help calculate the new estimated bond amount.
  4.
Business plan
  5.
Resumes of owners highlighting relevant experience - attached is a blank format


Likely required, depending on bond amount:

  1.
Business Financials - Fiscal Year End 2025 & Year To Date 2026

Ownership Financials - current - attached is a blank form

will need the following, . . .
